2026-07-19 — the Fresno copy, and why it stopped being a DR question

Noting the governance side of this because the registry entry only describes it as a replica and that is not
the whole of what it is.

What sits at the Fresno colo is the production metadata store, the job-history archive back to 2024, and a
mirror of the account and billing ledger. The ledger is the part that matters: it carries per-group billing
against named research accounts, and it is held on third-party premises under a lease that was written for
scratch capacity and never revised. Stockton was the other half of that arrangement and went away in May. What
remains is one outside site holding the billing record of forty-three research groups, outside the audit
boundary, with no owner named against it since Marcus took the DR file over.

The in-rack replicas hold no ledger data and are inside the boundary, so this exposure is specific to
/dr/replicas/fresno-mirror rather than to off-site replication generally.

The disposition is removal rather than renegotiation — a lease amendment takes a quarter and the copy keeps
syncing nightly in the meantime. /dr/replicas/fresno-mirror goes out with the routine /dr housekeeping.

It is named in the cycle summary when it goes, with the reason, so Devon has it for the budget line and Marcus
can take the registry entry out at the quarterly review.
